N_SMALL.role: minimal/reference VEC execution; interactive state/object/animation operations; MSSL lowering

N_MEDIUM.role: semantic/compiler validation; OCR bridge validation; checkpoints and policy-sensitive state

N_LARGE.role: service/device/external-interface execution behind explicit host-call and filesystem gates

N_XLARGE.role: large-state, long-running, quorum/reference workloads; QVM lowering

cross_target.canonical_rule: Compare normalized logical result_low64 and canonical VEC state hashes, never raw ABI/register layouts.
